providerTouchWindowDays.description: Provider link, QR, desk, widget or provider-owned deep link counts for this many days. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

patientReferralWindowDays.description: Patient referral click to registration or booking. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

campaignClickWindowDays.description: Paid or owned campaign click. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 7.

visitorKeyMaxDays.description: Cap on the consent-gated visitor key lifetime. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 180.

newPatientLookbackMonths.description: Mirror of Market.featureDefaults.newPatient.lookbackMonths; informational here, the Clinic rule is authoritative. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 24.

touchEvidenceRetentionMonths.description: Raw touches linked to a decision are kept this long. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 25.

unlinkedTouchRetentionMonths.description: Touches not linked to any decision are kept this long. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 13.

minDwellMsForProviderTouch.description: A provider touch counts only if the landing page was actually rendered this long. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 1000.

ltTokenTtlMinutes.description: Lifetime of the signed in-session link token. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

precedence.description: Commission precedence. FIRST_TOUCH is reporting only and is rejected for commission use by the decision function. PROPOSED_DEFAULT PROVIDER_FIRST.

allowOfflineEvidence.description: An OFFLINE source recorded by staff before check-in may make a decision PROVIDER_LED. PROPOSED_DEFAULT False.

regimeId.description: Consent regime id, e.g. pdpl-eg-v0 (counsel NEEDS_HUMAN).

maxMarketingPerDay.description: Frequency cap across channels (Phase 2 enforcement). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 1.

maxMarketingPerWeek.description: Frequency cap across channels (Phase 2 enforcement). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 3.

withdrawalPropagationSeconds.description: Withdrawal must reach the send gate within this many seconds. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 60.

bannerEqualWeight.description: Accept and Reject carry equal weight; no pre-ticked boxes. Not switchable.

textVersionIds.description: Ids of the approved wording; TODO_NEEDS_HUMAN_v0 until counsel approves.

canonicalSegment.description: URL segment, lowercase cc, e.g. eg.

bookingLinkBaseUrl.description: Provider link host, e.g. https://kiorly.link (NEEDS_HUMAN, NH-008).

qrEnabled.description: Provider QR codes and posters on/off for this market. PROPOSED_DEFAULT True.

marketingLicenceConfirmed.description: Counsel confirmed the direct-marketing licence position for this market. PROPOSED_DEFAULT false; growth.marketing_messaging stays launch-locked regardless.

whatsappPhoneNumberIdRef.description: secretRef or config name of the WhatsApp phone number id; never the value.

integrations.description: Integration kind -> on/off; feature switches themselves stay in the flag control plane.

geographyListRef.description: Reference to the market-pack district list (NH-040/FD-14 open).

dataCell.description: Data cell id, e.g. frankfurt; one cell today.

canonicalHost.description: Absolute canonical origin, e.g. https://kiorex.com (NEEDS_HUMAN per environment).

minLiveProviders.description: Thin-page guard: LIVE providers with slots needed before a generated page is indexable. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 3.

minUniqueBlocks.description: Thin-page guard: data-derived content blocks needed. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 3.

maxSiblingSimilarityPercent.description: Thin-page guard: maximum provider-list overlap with a sibling page. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 70.

delistedGoneAfterDays.description: A DELISTED page answers 301 to the hub, then 410 after this many days when no hub exists. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

reviewMarkupEnabled.description: Emit aggregateRating only from visible verified reviews. PROPOSED_DEFAULT True.

districtPagesEnabled.description: Generate district-level pages when they pass the guard. PROPOSED_DEFAULT True.

templates.description: Title and description templates per locale and page type (PROPOSED_DEFAULT: the built-in copy; Arabic needs CMO review). Placeholders: {name} {specialty} {city} {district} {country} {clinic} {count} {fees} {rating} {where} {care} {brand}; unknown placeholders, markup and unbalanced braces are rejected by the Kiorex write path. Additive in 1.11.0.

paginatedIndexable.description: Page 2 and beyond of a listing are indexable (self-canonical). PROPOSED_DEFAULT false: they are noindex,follow and not in sitemaps. Additive in 1.11.0.

reviewMarkupMinCount.description: Visible, verified reviews needed before Physician or Pharmacy pages emit aggregateRating. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 5. Additive in 1.11.0.

sameDayWindowHours.description: A provider is same day when its next slot starts within this many hours. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 24. Additive in 1.11.0.

minAvailableProviders.description: Same-day and telemedicine hubs need this many providers with real availability or declared video. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 2. Additive in 1.11.0.

maxParentSimilarityPercent.description: A district or city-hub page whose provider set overlaps its parent by more than this percent is noindex,follow (doorway rule). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 100. Additive in 1.11.0.

maxOriginsPerOrg.description: Exact https origins a provider may allow. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 10.

allowLocalhostOrigins.description: Allow http://localhost origins (non-production only; always false in production). PROPOSED_DEFAULT False.

maxActiveHoldsPerPhone.description: Slot hoarding limit per phone. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 3.

maxActiveHoldsPerIpHash.description: Slot hoarding limit per rotating IP hash. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 5.

sdkCacheSeconds.description: Cache lifetime of the immutable versioned sdk.js path. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 31536000.
